CHN.note: World's largest producer and importer; FAOSTAT/USDA PSD sheep+goat meat. Comtrade 2024 imports 366 kt (AUS 191, NZL 168). Domestic flock expansion has not closed the deficit.

AUS.note: World #1 sheepmeat exporter (lamb+mutton). MLA reports record 2024 exports near 0.65 Mt; key markets China, USA, Middle East, Malaysia.

NZL.note: World #2 exporter; over 85% of production exported. China, UK, USA, Netherlands top destinations. Flock decline pressuring volumes.

GBR.note: Large EU-facing exporter (mainly to France) and re-importer of NZ/AUS lamb. Comtrade 2024 imports 70 kt; net modestly positive on volume.

IND.note: Major goat/mutton producer (FAOSTAT); most consumed domestically. Small mutton/sheep exports to Gulf.

ESP.note: Leading EU lamb exporter; ships to France, Italy, Portugal and live/meat to Middle East and North Africa.

FRA.note: Europe's largest sheepmeat-deficit market. Comtrade 2024 imports 120 kt led by UK 71, IE 15, Spain 14, NZ 12.

USA.note: Structurally short on lamb; Comtrade 2024 imports 165 kt, ~78% Australia, ~21% NZ. Domestic flock at multi-decade lows.

SAU.note: Large Gulf importer of chilled/frozen sheepmeat plus live sheep (Hajj/Eid demand). Sources Australia, Sudan, India, Spain.

ARE.note: Gulf import-and-reexport hub; imports lamb/mutton from Australia, India, Somalia and redistributes regionally.

MYS.note: Near-total import dependence; Australia is the dominant supplier (AUS->MYS 39 kt). Halal mutton demand.

NLD.note: EU trade/processing hub; imports NZ lamb (NZL->NLD 23 kt) and re-exports within the EU.

DEU.note: Comtrade 2024 imports 42 kt led by NZ 16, Ireland 10, Netherlands 5, UK 4.

QAT.note: High-income Gulf importer; sources from Australia, India and the region. Live sheep also significant.

KOR.note: Fast-growing lamb market; Australia is the leading supplier (AUS->KOR 21 kt).

IRL.note: Significant EU lamb exporter to France, Germany, UK (IRL->FRA 15 kt). Production exceeds domestic consumption.

flows.note: UN Comtrade 2024 (China-reported): China imported 191 kt of sheep/goat meat from Australia (HS 0204). FAOSTAT seed 186 kt; mirror within 3%. The largest sheepmeat flow in the world.
UN Comtrade 2024 (China-reported): China imported 167 kt of sheep/goat meat from New Zealand (HS 0204). FAOSTAT seed confirms exactly.
UN Comtrade 2024 (USA-reported): the US imported 128 kt of lamb/mutton from Australia (HS 0204). Confirmed exactly.
UN Comtrade 2024 (France-reported): France imported 71 kt of sheepmeat from the UK (HS 0204). The UK's single largest sheepmeat market.
UN Comtrade 2024 (UK-reported): the UK imported 41 kt of lamb from New Zealand (HS 0204) under NZ's tariff-rate quota.
FAOSTAT 2024: Australia is Malaysia's dominant halal mutton supplier (~39 kt, HS 0204).
UN Comtrade 2024 (USA-reported): the US imported 35 kt of lamb from New Zealand (HS 0204).
FAOSTAT 2024: NZ lamb enters the EU via the Netherlands hub (~23 kt, HS 0204) for onward distribution.
FAOSTAT 2024: Australia supplies chilled/frozen sheepmeat to Saudi Arabia (~23 kt) alongside live sheep.
FAOSTAT 2024: Korea is a fast-growing Australian lamb market (~21 kt, HS 0204).
UN Comtrade 2024 (UK-reported): the UK imported 18 kt of lamb from Australia (HS 0204) under post-FTA quota access.
FAOSTAT 2024: Japan is a steady Australian mutton/lamb destination (~16 kt, HS 0204).
FAOSTAT 2024: intra-Central-Asia sheepmeat trade (~16 kt), largely overland.
UN Comtrade 2024 (France-reported): France imported 15 kt of lamb from Ireland (HS 0204).
UN Comtrade 2024 (France-reported): France imported 13.8 kt of lamb from Spain (HS 0204) — Spain's leading EU lamb flow.
UN Comtrade 2024 (France-reported): France imported 12.0 kt of NZ tariff-quota lamb (HS 0204).
UN Comtrade 2024 (Germany-reported): Germany imported 16.2 kt of lamb from New Zealand (HS 0204) — its top sheepmeat supplier.
UN Comtrade 2024 (Germany-reported): Germany imported 10.0 kt of lamb from Ireland (HS 0204).
FAOSTAT/MLA 2024: Australian sheepmeat to the UAE Gulf hub (~12 kt); UAE re-exports regionally.
UN Comtrade 2024 (UK-reported): the UK imported 7.0 kt of lamb from Ireland (HS 0204) — cross-border trade.
FAOSTAT/MLA 2024: Australian lamb/mutton to Qatar (~8 kt); high per-capita Gulf demand.
UN Comtrade 2024 (Germany-reported): Germany imported 5.0 kt of sheepmeat from the Netherlands (HS 0204) — EU re-export flow.
UN Comtrade 2024 (Germany-reported): Germany imported 3.7 kt of sheepmeat from the UK (HS 0204).
FAOSTAT 2024: Spanish lamb to Italy (~9 kt, HS 0204); seasonal Easter/Christmas demand.
FAOSTAT 2024: Indian mutton/sheepmeat to the UAE (~9 kt); India supplies frozen product across the Gulf.
UN Comtrade 2024 (China-reported): China imported 5.5 kt of lamb from Uruguay (HS 0204) — South American lamb.
FAOSTAT/FAO 2024: Sudanese sheep/sheepmeat to Saudi Arabia (~8 kt); long-standing Red Sea livestock corridor.

rankings.note: Exporters from FAOSTAT/USDA PSD 2024 balances (Australia and NZ together ~60% of world sheepmeat trade). Importers cross-checked against UN Comtrade 2024 reporter imports (China, USA, France, UK, Germany confirmed to within rounding).

global.note: World sheep+goat meat (FAOSTAT/OECD-FAO). Production ~17 Mt in 2024, led by China, India, then Australia/NZ/Africa. Only ~12% of output is internationally traded; Australia+NZ supply ~60% of that trade.
